title: Which Rom-Com Couple Matches Your Relationship Energy?
description: Every relationship has its own unique vibe! Answer 12 questions to discover which iconic romantic comedy couple best represents your relationship dynamic.

questions.text: How would your partner describe your ideal date night?

options.text: Something spontaneous and adventurous - maybe getting lost in the city together
A cozy dinner where we can talk for hours
Something fun and active - mini golf, bowling, or a concert
Just relaxing at home with takeout and a movie

questions.text: What's your communication style as a couple?

options.text: We banter constantly and tease each other
We have deep, meaningful conversations about everything
We communicate through actions more than words
We keep it light and fun, avoiding heavy topics
We argue loudly but always make up passionately
We talk it through until we understand each other
We give each other space and come back when calm
One of us apologizes first and we move on
Watching movies and quoting our favorite lines
Exploring new restaurants and cafes
Playing games or doing something competitive
Long walks and deep conversations

questions.text: How do you show affection publicly?

options.text: We're not afraid to be affectionate - holding hands, hugs, quick kisses
We keep it subtle - a hand on the back, subtle touches
We tease each other and act like best friends
We express love through private moments
Enemies to lovers - we started off not liking each other
Friends to lovers - we were friends first
Class differences - we came from different worlds
Second chance - we reunited after being apart

questions.text: How would friends describe your relationship?

options.text: The couple that's always laughing
The couple that gives us hope about love
The most adorable couple we know
The couple we go to for advice

questions.text: What's your dream vacation as a couple?

options.text: A romantic European city like Paris or Venice
A cozy cabin in the mountains
An adventure trip - hiking, exploring, trying new things
A road trip with no specific destination

questions.text: How do you keep the spark alive?

options.text: Surprises and spontaneous dates
Trying new things together
Reliving our favorite memories
Honest conversations about our feelings

questions.text: What's your favorite thing about your relationship?

options.text: The excitement and passion
The comfort and safety I feel
How fun and easy it is to be together
How we balance each other out

questions.text: How do you handle the 'milestones' in your relationship?

options.text: We make big gestures for anniversaries and special moments
We celebrate but keep it personal and meaningful
We acknowledge them but don't make them too big of a deal
We use them as opportunities to reflect on our journey

questions.text: What song best describes your relationship?

options.text: An epic, passionate ballad
A fun, upbeat song about love
A sweet, acoustic love song
A classic love song that stands the test of time

results.title: Noah & Allie from The Notebook
results.description: Your relationship is defined by intense passion and deep emotional connection. Like Noah and Allie, you love with your whole heart and believe in love that transcends everything - time, circumstances, and obstacles. Your love story is the kind people write novels about.

results.title: Harry & Sally from When Harry Met Sally
results.description: Your relationship is built on deep friendship and intellectual connection. Like Harry and Sally, you started as friends who understood each other completely, and that foundation made your romantic connection even stronger. You prove that men and women can be friends... and so much more.

results.title: William & Anna from Notting Hill
results.description: Your relationship has that sweet, slightly awkward but utterly charming quality. Like William and Anna, you balance each other out - the everyday person and the extraordinary one. Your love is about accepting each other's worlds and finding magic in the ordinary.

results.title: Kat & Patrick from 10 Things I Hate About You
results.description: Your relationship is full of banter, wit, and that delicious tension of enemies-to-lovers. Like Kat and Patrick, you challenge each other and bring out sides of each other no one else can. Your love is passionate, a bit chaotic, and absolutely unforgettable.
